change: For each late ship (departure past due), try more cranes up to its maximum or an earlier berth hour, screen with ship_timeline, then check; lateness costs sections x hours.

Keep every scheduled ship on its planned section (each ship moved off it costs 5): start from baseline_plan, move ships back to their planned section one at a time, screen each with ship_timeline, then check.
Add up the cranes of every ship alongside in each hour and keep the total within the pool, less any crane outage; cut cranes on the ship with the most slack first.
Before choosing a berth hour, read the no_moves windows in the rules; never berth inside a no-movement window, berth at its end.
